description: Cauze generatoare de incendii is a dataset listed in data.gov.ro, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerul Afacerilor Interne. Statistical data provided by the General Inspectorate for Emergency Situations regarding the causes that generated fires in the first 9 months of 2013. Coverage: Romania. The portal shows the English title as "Causes of fire" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministerul Afacerilor Interne. Its keywords include situatii urgenta. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLS. The listing shows 2014-11-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ro.
